title: Society Wives — Draft Mini-Arc Planner
basedOn: Dhika episode progression patterns: introductions, helper/twins encounters, friend-group visits, travel, and aftermath.
scope: Narrative plot/titles only. No established boundary-crossing events at opening.

episodes.title: EP 00 — Five Doors
episodes.plot: Five women's distinct home, marriage, profession and friendship worlds are established in Gulmohar Heights.

episodes.title: EP 01 — Morning Lift
episodes.plot: An ordinary shared morning introduces couples, parenting routines and the ease of old friendships.

episodes.title: EP 02 — The Chairman's Notice
episodes.plot: Mahendra announces society plans that bring younger helpers and elders into the same setting.

episodes.title: EP 03 — Before Duty Calls
episodes.plot: Five households juggle office departures, childcare and engagement planning on one calendar.

episodes.title: EP 04 — Dinner Without Invitations
episodes.plot: An unscheduled group evening reveals how much all the couples trust one another.

episodes.title: EP 05 — Small Private Impressions
episodes.plot: Each wife notices a different quality in a friend's husband without assuming a romance.

episodes.title: EP 06 — Forms and Admit Cards
episodes.plot: Adult devars and sisters seek exam and career help from the five professional women.

episodes.title: EP 07 — Saturday Guidance
episodes.plot: Shreya hosts police preparation, Ankita assists interviews and Shivani structures revision.

episodes.title: EP 08 — Two Seats at the Table
episodes.plot: Young adult students meet across families; one light crush develops inside the peer group.

episodes.title: EP 09 — Volunteers Required
episodes.plot: Sharmi assigns the five women different society event responsibilities.

episodes.title: EP 10 — The Recently Married Guests
episodes.plot: Soniya and Rahul visit and become recurring social participants rather than background relatives.

episodes.title: EP 11 — Everyone Knows Everyone
episodes.plot: A dinner shows the existing friendly teasing, mutual support and clear boundaries.

episodes.title: EP 12 — Two Mock Interviews
episodes.plot: Karan and Aman ask their bhabhi for help while preparing for Shreya's coaching session.

episodes.title: EP 13 — Rinku's Repair Visit
episodes.plot: A society helper becomes familiar through recurring maintenance work and respectful conversation.

episodes.title: EP 14 — A Compliment Remembered
episodes.plot: Ankita notices a small moment of attention but keeps it separate from her marriage and daily routine.

episodes.title: EP 15 — Two New Collaborators
episodes.plot: Vivan and Reyansh join Ankita's project with contrasting work styles.

episodes.title: EP 16 — Twenty Minutes Offline
episodes.plot: A production incident creates intense teamwork and unexpected appreciation.

episodes.title: EP 17 — The Unsent Message
episodes.plot: Ankita privately questions why an ordinary colleague's compliment stayed in her mind.

episodes.title: EP 18 — Last Period
episodes.plot: Shivani prepares a school cultural function while arranging Tara's childcare.

episodes.title: EP 19 — The Rehearsal Rescue
episodes.plot: School staff help with a technical mishap, developing professional trust.

episodes.title: EP 20 — After the Applause
episodes.plot: An admirer makes a gentle, awkward impression that Shivani does not pursue.

episodes.title: EP 21 — Three Calendars
episodes.plot: Audit deadlines and wedding planning collide as Soniya arrives to help.

episodes.title: EP 22 — The Article Assistant
episodes.plot: Punit earns Taniya's respect during a difficult audit.

episodes.title: EP 23 — Soniya's Question
episodes.plot: Soniya raises a candid question about attraction, commitment and independence.

episodes.title: EP 24 — Night Shift
episodes.plot: Meenakshi balances hospital duty with a missed family dinner.

episodes.title: EP 25 — A Reliable Assistant
episodes.plot: Naveen handles an urgent logistics issue and earns professional confidence.

episodes.title: EP 26 — The Unexpected Thanks
episodes.plot: Meenakshi reflects on being seen as a person beyond her responsibilities.

episodes.title: EP 27 — Two New Trainees
episodes.plot: A police trainee pair joins Shreya's unit and begins to learn her leadership style.

episodes.title: EP 28 — A Long Report
episodes.plot: Teamwork during a demanding duty shift reveals trust and admiration.

episodes.title: EP 29 — The Line of Respect
episodes.plot: Shreya notices personal admiration but maintains clear authority and boundaries.

episodes.title: EP 30 — Six Men at Breakfast
episodes.plot: Fathers-in-law and the chairman form a recurring society committee.

episodes.title: EP 31 — A Courtesy Visit
episodes.plot: Rajeev visits another family's home on genuine committee business and notices an unspoken attraction.

episodes.title: EP 32 — The Things Unsaid
episodes.plot: Older men's private admiration remains one-sided, with no assumed response from the women.

arcs.title: Ankita & the Office Pair — Part I

episodes.title: EP 33 — Two Solutions
episodes.plot: The office pair compete over a design choice and reveal distinct personalities.

episodes.title: EP 34 — Lift After Hours
episodes.plot: A short after-work conversation feels unexpectedly personal to Ankita.

episodes.title: EP 35 — The Next Sprint
episodes.plot: Ankita decides how to keep professional collaboration uncomplicated while feelings remain uncertain.

arcs.title: Shivani & the Event Twins — Part I

episodes.title: EP 36 — Identical Names on the Roster
episodes.plot: Twin event coordinators Ayaan and Armaan assist Shivani with society preparations.

episodes.title: EP 37 — The Poster Room
episodes.plot: Shivani gets to know each twin individually during a supervised planning session.

episodes.title: EP 38 — The Unfinished Compliment
episodes.plot: One twin's quiet crush becomes visible; Shivani remains kind and clear about boundaries.

arcs.title: Taniya & the Audit Pair — Part I

episodes.title: EP 39 — The Ledger Problem
episodes.plot: Taniya and two young colleagues correct a difficult set of accounts.

episodes.title: EP 40 — Coffee After Closing
episodes.plot: Friendly debates reveal the two colleagues' contrasting admiration for her.

episodes.title: EP 41 — Client Dinner
episodes.plot: A senior partner invites the team to a work event, creating a separate professional tension thread.

arcs.title: Meenakshi & the Wellness Twins — Part I

episodes.title: EP 42 — A New Health Programme
episodes.plot: Two wellness-coach twins seek medical oversight for a society initiative.

episodes.title: EP 43 — The Trial Session
episodes.plot: Working together in public lets Meenakshi notice their different temperaments.

episodes.title: EP 44 — The Quiet Crush
episodes.plot: One twin develops an unspoken interest while Meenakshi sees mostly professional enthusiasm.

arcs.title: Shreya & the Study Twins — Part I

episodes.title: EP 45 — Saturday Mock Interviews
episodes.plot: Shreya coaches police aspirants Karan and Aman, joined by Manav.

episodes.title: EP 46 — The Unexpected Question
episodes.plot: The students' different reactions make the group feel more personal and familiar.

episodes.title: EP 47 — Mentor First
episodes.plot: Shreya handles a carefully worded compliment without confusing mentoring with romance.

episodes.title: EP 48 — The Second Service Call
episodes.plot: Recurring apartment repairs introduce an everyday support-person storyline.

episodes.title: EP 49 — A Corridor Joke
episodes.plot: A friendly exchange is noticed by someone else and misinterpreted.

episodes.title: EP 50 — A Different Kind of Attention
episodes.plot: Ankita thinks about the difference between appreciation, flattery and attraction.

arcs.title: Shivani & the Rehearsal Team — Part II

episodes.title: EP 51 — The Missing Props
episodes.plot: A school-stage mishap creates another shared professional challenge.

episodes.title: EP 52 — The Photograph
episodes.plot: A harmless photograph triggers teasing and an unexpectedly private reaction.

episodes.title: EP 53 — After the Function
episodes.plot: Shivani considers whether familiarity has changed how one colleague sees her.

episodes.title: EP 54 — The Returning Sister
episodes.plot: Recently married Soniya takes an active role in wedding preparations.

episodes.title: EP 55 — Rhea's Visit
episodes.plot: Rhea seeks career guidance while Rahul joins household conversations, opening a new crossover route.

episodes.title: EP 56 — Two Marriages, Two Questions
episodes.plot: Taniya and Soniya discuss emotional expectations without equating attraction with betrayal.

episodes.title: EP 57 — The Volunteer Call
episodes.plot: Meenakshi organises a medical camp and Babloo coordinates supplies.

episodes.title: EP 58 — The Missing Box
episodes.plot: An ordinary logistics problem creates a memorable teamwork moment.

episodes.title: EP 59 — When the Guests Leave
episodes.plot: Meenakshi reflects on becoming more visible in the larger society circle.

arcs.title: Shreya & the Station Pair — Part II

episodes.title: EP 60 — Field Exercise
episodes.plot: Shreya leads the trainee pair in a difficult operational test.

episodes.title: EP 61 — Unexpected Backup
episodes.plot: A colleague supports her during a difficult day, strengthening professional trust.

episodes.title: EP 62 — Roll-Call Rumour
episodes.plot: Unwanted gossip tests Shreya's authority and reinforces her boundaries.

episodes.title: EP 63 — Study Room Sunday
episodes.plot: Younger adults from different households prepare together for interviews and exams.

episodes.title: EP 64 — Two Seats by the Window
episodes.plot: A possible peer-to-peer romance develops between two unattached adults.

episodes.title: EP 65 — Before the Rumours
episodes.plot: Friends clarify their feelings and try to protect the wider study circle from gossip.

episodes.title: EP 66 — Everyone Brings Something
episodes.plot: A rotating dinner brings friends and spouses together in a smaller setting.

episodes.title: EP 67 — The Compliment That Travelled
episodes.plot: A joke is interpreted differently by three people, exposing the limits of shared familiarity.

episodes.title: EP 68 — Two Drives Home
episodes.plot: Two couples talk honestly about boundaries, attraction and trust in different ways.

episodes.title: EP 69 — Names on the List
episodes.plot: A weekend outing is planned only after duty rosters, childcare and travel logistics are settled.

episodes.title: EP 70 — The Resort Arrival
episodes.plot: A new setting changes the conversational pairings without changing established relationships overnight.

episodes.title: EP 71 — The Evening Walk
episodes.plot: Private conversations reveal different emotional directions for each lead.

episodes.title: EP 72 — Breakfast by the Pool
episodes.plot: After the first evening, several people reflect on harmless moments that nevertheless felt important.

episodes.title: EP 73 — The Lost Room Key
episodes.plot: An ordinary mix-up pairs unexpected friends for an illuminating short conversation.

episodes.title: EP 74 — The Ride Back
episodes.plot: Each woman returns with a distinct unresolved question that belongs to her own story.

episodes.title: EP 75 — Different Mondays
episodes.plot: The five women return to different professions and process the weekend separately.

episodes.title: EP 76 — The Message Not Sent
episodes.plot: A few characters choose restraint, clarity or distance over impulsive escalation.

episodes.title: EP 77 — The Sisters' Pact
episodes.plot: The women reaffirm friendship while admitting that not all feelings can be planned.

episodes.title: EP 78 — The Next Release
episodes.plot: Ankita's office pair returns to a new assignment, setting up a possible second mini-arc.

episodes.title: EP 79 — Four Different Invitations
episodes.plot: The other four women receive distinct work and society opportunities tied to existing people.

episodes.title: EP 80 — Another Society Sunday
episodes.plot: One gathering opens the door to later parts without forcing all relationships forward together.
